name: Shovel
lead: A shovel is a tiered tool that can quickly break sand , gravel , and dirt -related blocks. Shovels also have a unique use interaction with dirt-related blocks and snow layers ‌ [ Bedrock Edition only ] and can turn them into dirt paths or snowballs respectively.
In ancient_city/city_center/city_center_2 , there exists a furnace with a wooden shovel inside.

recipes.ingredients: Any Planks or Gold Ingot or Any stone-tier block or Copper Ingot or Iron Ingot or Diamond + Stick
